Hmm, but it has been charging for a long time — I guess it should have power. I remember charging it yesterday." I take a look at his glasses and find they're out of power. I'm helping him fix his glasses.

[DAY1 20:27:00 - DAY1 20:27:29]
I notice my phone hasn't connected to the glasses yet and I'm still trying. I tap and swipe the glasses' screen for Lucia and say, "OK." I discover the glasses are out of battery and say, "Oh, it's out of battery." I ask, "Why—did it not charge?" I realize it probably didn't charge last night and notice the power bank's data cable wasn't plugged in, so it's not charging. I say, "It's okay, it seems like it wasn't plugged in properly." Lucia says, "Ah, it shouldn't be." I say, "Maybe not." Lucia says, "It seems it can only be plugged in this far." I say, "Ah, only this far?" and, "Then it wasn't unplugged." Lucia says, "There is a section here but maybe it got disconnected in the middle."

[DAY1 20:10:00 - DAY1 20:20:00]
I was engaged in multitasking between my phone and computer. Initially, I was captivated by the content on my phone, swiping and playing with it while also typing. The screen showed a chat conversation, and I adjusted my glasses to continue typing on the phone. A laptop was on next to me, displaying some files, and on the desk, there was a yellow plush cushion and a phone charger.

Later, I transitioned to working on my laptop in the living room. I sat cross-legged on the floor with the laptop open, its light reflecting on my face, while I thought about some problems. Tasha interacted with me, suggesting a placement for cupcakes, which prompted me to look up and then stand up. I continued pondering issues before standing again.

I then organized my workspace for comfort. I squatted down to pick up an orange flower-shaped cushion, placed it under me, and settled on the sofa to operate the laptop placed there. The screen displayed applications and files, and the room contained a tripod and a cluttered table. After shutting down one computer, I focused on the other one nearby, noticing the dim light and a cute lion-shaped pillow on the sofa.

To conclude my activities, I adjusted my glasses, then took them off and carefully placed them on the ground, amidst a quiet environment with only the sound of the computer and my movements.
